evidence.expiry: 『Our licenses expire on the following dates』『our existing Abercrombie & Fitch and Hollister fragrance license agreement will expire on March 14, 2028』『The Dunhill fragrance license expired on September 30, 2023 and was not renewed』→ライセンス期限依存の業態=yes
evidence.moatdecay: 『we are encouraged by our performance in 2025 as we have been able to maintain market share』『should help us gain market share』→シェア維持/拡大=no
evidence.erosion: 蝕: シェア維持が明示(『maintain market share』2025)・ブランド portfolio 拡大中(Off-White/Goutal/Solférino)。粗利0.3%浸食は関税起因の軽微=none
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションに技術破壊ヒットなし。香水カテゴリに代替技術なし=settled
evidence.dom: 『Macy's, our top retail customer, accounted for approximately 10% of net sales in 2025』+prestige fragrance は競合(Coty/Puig/Estée等)多数・全体シェア小=競争市場50
evidence.irr: 『In 2019, we entered into an exclusive, 10-year worldwide license agreement』『Jimmy Choo — In 2009, we entered into an exclusive 12-year worldwide li[cense]』Lacoste『will last for 15 years』→長期排他契約で契約中の移行摩擦高い=70(満了時は代替可でありrep/expiryで別途評価)
evidence.rep: ブランドIPは licensor 所有で IPAR 固有資産ではなく、満了時に競合(Coty/Puig等)がライセンス入札・製造代替可能。『The Dunhill fragrance license expired...and was not renewed』が交代の実例=数年で追随可35
evidence.dur: 堀ヒットなし。ブランド価値は licensor 帰属。IPAR の保護は運用統合・製造/流通/規制登録のスイッチングコスト=75
evidence.geopol: 『Approximately 50% of net sales of our European based operations are denominated in U.S. dollars』『tariffs resulted in $12.8 million in higher costs in 2025 or 0.9% of sales』→FX/関税リスク中程度・一国集中なし=1
evidence.p3: nde=0.13(純負債僅少)・現金+STI が総負債をほぼ相殺=<1→85
evidence.p4: 『we did not maintain effective internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025, as the Company has not remediated the material weakness』『a material weakness related to the design and implementation of our risk assessment process remains as of December 31, 2025』=実指摘→50
evidence.f2: 『we plan to continue to make investments in fast-growing markets and channels to grow market share』大市場(prestige fragrance)に対し売上約1.5Bで一桁%浸透=80
evidence.f3: R&D非該当業態(A&P約21%)。シェア趨勢は『maintain market share』2025+『grow market share』戦略で片方+=75
evidence.f4: 『the proprietary brand Solférino, a collection of niche fragrances which we launched in 2025』+Off-White/Goutal のIP取得=自社ブランド育成中60
